combo_label: London Underground × Volcanoes × The Canterbury Tales

entries.clue: Thick and slow-flowing, like cold honey tipped from a jar
Attendant to a mounted warrior; here that veteran's curly-haired son of twenty
Aeolian island long called the lighthouse of the Mediterranean
Of rock born from a melt, rather than laid down in patient layers
Holy tomb that draws the faithful; theirs stood behind the high altar
Travel astride a horse, or a spin on a fairground machine
Herald's sleeveless overcoat, and the name of the inn where they set out
Slight shudder of the ground, or the unsteady shake of an old hand
West London suburb, home to the world's oldest working film studio
Circus below the West End where three busy lines cross under the shops
